content.short: EigenDA is a high-throughput Data Availability (DA) service on EigenLayer, providing rollups with cheap, secure storage.
content.description: EigenDA is a high-throughput Data Availability (DA) service built on EigenLayer. Designed for Ethereum rollups, it allows them to store transaction data efficiently at a fraction of the cost of mainnet. By leveraging the massive economic security of EigenLayer's restaking pool, EigenDA ensures data remains accessible and secure while offering linear scalability as more operators join. The service targets throughputs exceeding 10 MB/s, making it a cornerstone for scaling Ethereum. It provides the infrastructure for rollups to process millions of transactions without compromising on security or cost, enabling massive data throughput for next-generation dapps.
